permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to your paired Orca desktop.
permissions._devOnlyNote: R4 (unresolved): Orca desktop endpoints are arbitrary ws://<lan-ip>:<port> / Tailscale hosts, not fixed origins, so no fully-qualified whitelist entry exists yet. `whitelist` is intentionally empty — do NOT fill it with prose or a placeholder origin; Even may enforce it against WebSocket dials verbatim. This manifest is NOT portal-submission-ready: it only supports the v1 QR-sideloaded dev URL. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-even-g2-app-design.md §12 risk R4 before any hub.evenrealities.com submission.
